cues.note: The author's song. The script's own score cue sits at the tail of scene 74 ('Only now does the SCORE enter'), so the song enters 14 seconds before the end of 74 and carries the stills (75), Vera's call (76) and Jack at his desk (77). Change `from`, `to`, `startOffset` to move it.
End credits: a black tail after scene 100 with the full song. `seek` is where in the song to start (seconds), `length` the tail length. Credit lines are placeholders.
